verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents querying data directly from S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage, with stored S3 credentials via CREATE SECRET. Its DuckLake lakehouse can also run over your own object storage (a DATA_PATH on s3://), so data can stay in your buckets rather than proprietary storage. However, the evidence never names Iceberg, Delta or Parquet. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Iceberg and Delta table reads, explicit Parquet-on-object-storage querying, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-place querying.
